title: Lotus Sorceress
description: A female figure with green plant-like skin stands in a lush garden, her head replaced by a large glowing pink lotus flower. She raises one hand as colorful meteors streak across a dramatic sunset sky, scattering sparks and petals around her.
prompt: A surreal female nature spirit with green skin made of leaves, vines and flowers stands in a mystical garden at dusk. Her head is a large glowing pink lotus flower. She raises one hand as vibrant colorful meteors and shooting stars streak across an orange and purple sunset sky, releasing sparks and petals. Lush oversized plants and flowers surround her, dramatic cinematic lighting, intricate details, vibrant colors.
